title: Anti-racism work and housing funding requests
subtitle: Also: arts grants, affordable housing roadmap, consumption site evaluation, neighbourhood safety program and infectious disease report.
overview: The Community and Health Services Committee recommended a new way for community organizations to ask the Region for housing-first funding. Under the proposed protocol, requests would be evaluated and answered through a set process starting with the 2024 budget. The committee also recommended that the Chief Administrative Officer look at ways to embed reconciliation, equity, diversity and inclusion in Regional operations. Options include continuing a team of community connectors, working with a new REDI Action Partnership, and placing the two related directors on the Corporate Leadership Team. The resolution was added after notice was waived, and members noted that motions without notice should be avoided where possible.

The committee recommended $340,000 in 2023 Major Arts and Culture Organizations grants through the consent agenda. It also received several reports for information, including the 10-Year Housing and Homelessness Plan annual report and the consumption and treatment services evaluation. Staff said the Region is awaiting provincial information on inhalation services.

On the Building Better Futures update, staff said funding from the Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation will not be available as budgeted. Sources of funding for the 2,500-home goal will need to change, with the greatest effect expected on the 2025 budget. A closed session followed on a property security matter.

decisions.detail: The committee recommended that Housing Services staff adopt a protocol for evaluating and responding to new housing-first fee-for-service requests from community partners, beginning with the 2024 budget process {{vote:m3}}.

The committee recommended that the CAO consider ways to embed reconciliation, equity, diversity and inclusion in Regional work, including community connectors, a REDI Action Partnership and Corporate Leadership Team roles, and that the resolution go to area municipalities {{vote:m5}}.
The committee recommended approving $340,000 in 2023 funding allocations under the Major Arts and Culture Organizations grant program.

The committee received the consent items for information and approved them, including the housing plan annual report, the neighbourhood safety program evaluation and the 2022 infectious disease highlights {{vote:m1}}.
